verdict.rationale: Wave ships several fixed, pre-built automations tied to events (auto-import/categorize bank transactions, automatic overdue-invoice reminders, recurring invoices/auto-billing) per wave-docs-2, wave-docs-10, wave-docs-25, wave-docs-24, wave-supp-invoicing. However, these are built-in toggles, not a general rules engine where an AI-native user can define arbitrary custom rules for arbitrary events/actions; no API, webhook, or automation-builder surface is documented (wave-supp-dev-portal-wall, wave-probe-1, wave-probe-2). Missing for 10: user-definable custom rule/trigger system, webhook/event API for arbitrary actions, documentation of an automation builder beyond a handful of fixed features.
